label: Unattributed website author, Necessary…: Necessarily, every cause-capable thing included in a…
locator: A2C, steps 1–4 and 7, with entire/ungrounded/head title attributes
interpretation: One coherent qualified closure/head commitment: an entire chain excludes outside causes of its members; each concrete chain-member is asserted to occur in an entire chain; closure plus internal head-uncausation yields uncausation. This is the source's asserted extension, not a stronger statement that every original chain as a whole is included in one larger linear chain. The step3 by-definition label supplies no independent metaphysical warrant.
